Description.span:
This component splits data acquired by the sbgECom device component into vectors of data with standard data types (integers, floats, doubles...) on outputs corresponding to the different message types provided by the device. Update in version 2.0.0
Some breaking changes were introduced in version 2.0.0 to upgrade SDK to version 5.4.1684. This introduces changes to the following properties:
  • output_ship_motion_1, output_ship_motion_2 etc.: Ship motions are unified into just one field in the new version. Therefore, these properties are removed and only output_ship_motion_0 remains.
  • output_ship_motion_hp_1, output_ship_motion_hp_1 etc.: Ship motions HP are unified into just one field in the new version. Therefore, these properties are removed and only output_ship_motion_hp_0 remains.
...and to the following outputs:
  • ship_motion_1, ship_motion_2 etc.: Ship motions are unified into just one field in the new version. Therefore, these outputs are removed and only ship_motion_0 remains.
  • ship_motion_hp_1, ship_motion_hp_1 etc.: Ship motions HP are unified into just one field in the new version. Therefore, these outputs are removed and only ship_motion_hp_0 remains.

Status general, clock, com aiding, solution, heave.
Vector of 3 MAPSUInt32:
  • General status bitmask and enums.
  • Communication status bitmask and enums.
  • Aiding equipments status bitmask and enums.

Vector of 9 MAPSInt32:
  • Year for example: 2013.
  • Month in year [1 .. 12].
  • Day in month [1 .. 31].
  • Hour in day [0 .. 23].
  • Minute in hour [0 .. 59].
  • Second in minute [0 .. 60]. (60 is used only when a leap second is added)
  • Nanosecond of current second in ns.
  • GPS time of week in ms.
  • Status. Reserved for future use.
UTC time in microseconds (1 MAPSInt64).

Vector of 4 MAPSFloat32:
  • X accelerometer in m.s^-2.
  • Y accelerometer in m.s^-2.
  • Z accelerometer in m.s^-2.
  • IMU status bitmask.

Vector of 4 MAPSFloat32:
  • X gyroscope in rad.s^-1.
  • Y gyroscope in rad.s^-1.
  • Z gyroscope in rad.s^-1.
  • IMU status bitmask.

Vector of 8 MAPSFloat32:
  • X, Y, Z delta velocity in m.s^-2.
  • X, Y, Z delta angle in rad.s^-1.
  • Internal temperature in °C.
  • IMU status bitmask.

Magnetic data with associated accelerometer on each axis.
Vector of 7 MAPSFloat32:
  • X, Y, Z magnetometer data in A.U.
  • X, Y, Z accelerometers in m.s^-2.
  • Magnetometer status bitmask.

Magnetometer calibration data (raw buffer)
Vector of 16 MAPSInt32.

Roll, pitch, yaw and their accuracies on each axis.
Vector of 7 MAPSFloat32:
  • Roll, Pitch and Yaw angles in rad.
  • Roll, Pitch and Yaw angles 1 sigma standard deviation in rad.
  • EKF solution status bitmask and enum.

EKF orientation in the form of a quaternion.
Vector of 8 MAPSFloat32:
  • Orientation quaternion stored in W, X, Y, Z form.
  • Roll, Pitch and Yaw angles 1 sigma standard deviation in rad.
  • EKF solution status bitmask and enum.

Position in NED coordinates with the accuracies on each axis.
Vector of 8 MAPSFloat64:
  • Latitude, Longitude in degrees positive North and East.
  • Latitude, longitude and altitude 1 sigma standard deviation in meters.
  • Undulation: Altitude difference between the geoid and the Ellipsoid in meters (Height above Ellipsoid = altitude + undulation).
  • EKF solution status bitmask and enum.

Velocities in NED coordinates with the accuracies on each axis.
Vector of 7 MAPSFloat32:
  • North, East, Down velocity in m.s^-1.
  • North, East, Down velocity 1 sigma standard deviation in m.s^-1.
  • EKF solution status bitmask and enum.

Heave, surge and sway and accelerations on each axis for up to 4 points.
Vector of 11 MAPSFloat32:
  • Surge, sway and heave in meters.
  • Surge, sway and heave velocities.
  • Surge, sway and heave ship Acceleration in m.s^-2.
  • Main heave period in seconds.
  • Ship Motion data status bitmask

GPS velocities from primary or secondary GPS receiver.
Vector of 10 MAPSFloat32:
  • GPS North, East, Down velocity in m.s^-1.
  • GPS North, East, Down velocity 1 sigma accuracy in m.s^-1.
  • Track ground course in degrees.
  • Course accuracy in degrees.
  • GPS time of week in ms.
  • GPS velocity status, type and bitmask.

GPS positions from primary or secondary GPS receiver.
Vector of 9 MAPSFloat64:
  • Latitude in degrees, positive north.
  • Longitude in degrees, positive east.
  • Altitude above Mean Sea Level in meters.
  • Undulation: altitude difference between the geoid and the Ellipsoid in meters (Height above Ellipsoid = altitude + undulation).
  • 1 sigma latitude accuracy in meters.
  • 1 sigma longitude accuracy in meters.
  • 1 sigma altitude accuracy in meters.
  • GPS time of week in ms.
  • GPS position status, type and bitmask.

GPS true heading from dual antenna system.
Vector of 6 MAPSFloat32:
  • GPS true heading in degrees.
  • GPS pitch angle measured from the master to the rover in degrees.
  • 1 sigma GPS true heading accuracy in degrees.
  • 1 signa GPS pitch angle accuarcy in degrees.
  • GPS time of week in ms.
  • GPS HDT status, type and bitmask.
GPS 1 raw data for post processing in the form of packets of bytes (Stream8).

GPS 2 velocity log data.
Vector of 10 MAPSFloat32:

  • GPS North, East, Down velocity 1 sigma accuracy in m.s^-1.
  • Track ground course in degrees.
  • Course accuracy in degrees.
  • GPS time of week in ms.
  • GPS velocity status, type and bitmask.

GPS 2 position log data.
Vector of 9 MAPSFloat64:
  • Latitude in degrees, positive north.
  • Longitude in degrees, positive east.
  • Altitude above Mean Sea Level in meters.
  • Undulation: altitude difference between the geoid and the Ellipsoid in meters (Height above Ellipsoid = altitude + undulation).
  • 1 sigma latitude accuracy in meters.
  • 1 sigma longitude accuracy in meters.
  • 1 sigma altitude accuracy in meters.
  • GPS time of week in ms.
  • GPS position status, type and bitmask.

GPS 2 true heading log data.
Vector of 6 MAPSFloat32:

  • GPS pitch angle measured from the master to the rover in degrees.
  • 1 sigma GPS true heading accuracy in degrees.
  • 1 signa GPS pitch angle accuarcy in degrees.

Provides odometer velocity.
Vector of 2 MAPSFloat32:
  • Velocity in m.s^-1 in the odometer direction.
  • Odometer velocity status bitmask.

Event markers sent when events are detected on sync in A pin.
Vector of 5 MAPSInt32:
  • Time offset for the second received event.
  • Time offset for the third received event.
  • Time offset for the fourth received event.
  • Time offset for the fifth received event.
  • Events status bitmask.

Event markers sent when events are detected on sync in B pin.
Vector of 5 MAPSInt32:

  • Time offset for the third received event.
  • Time offset for the fourth received event.
  • Time offset for the fifth received event.
  • Events status bitmask.

Event markers sent when events are detected on sync in C pin.
Vector of 5 MAPSInt32:
  • Time offset for the second received event.
  • Time offset for the third received event.
  • Time offset for the fourth received event.
  • Time offset for the fifth received event.
  • Events status bitmask.

Event markers sent when events are detected on sync in D pin.
Vector of 5 MAPSInt32:

  • Time offset for the fourth received event.

Doppler Velocity Log for bottom tracking data.
Vector of 7 MAPSFloat32:
  • X, Y, Z velocities in m.s^-1 expressed in the DVL instrument frame.
  • X, Y, Z velocities standard deviation in m.s^-1.
  • DVL status bitmask.

Delayed ship motion such as surge, sway, heave at the main monitoring point.
Vector of 11 MAPSFloat32:
  • Surge, sway and heave in meters.
  • Surge, sway and heave velocities.
  • Surge, sway and heave ship Acceleration in m.s^-2.
  • Main heave period in seconds.
  • Ship Motion data status bitmask

Pressure sensor such as depth sensor or altimeter.
Vector of 3 MAPSFloat32:
  • Pressure value in Pascals.
  • Altitude or depth in meters (positive up).
  • Pressure sensor status bitmask.

Raw USBL position data for subsea navigation.
Vector of 7 MAPSFloat32:
  • Latitude in degrees, positive north.
  • Longitude in degrees, positive east.
  • Depth in meters below mean sea level (positive down).
  • 1 sigma latitude accuracy in meters.
  • 1 sigma longitude accuracy in meters.
  • 1 sigma depth accuracy in meters.
  • Pressure sensor status bitmask.

Timestamp in microseconds (MAPSInt64) as sent by the device along with the messages hereabove. Each time a message is sent by the device, it also published the corresponding hardware timestamp from the device on this output.

Accepts messages published by the sbgECom device component in the form of a custom C data structure.
Input filter is defined as follows :

const MAPSTypeFilterBase MAPSFilterSbgEComData = MAPSFilterUserStructure(SbgEComData);

For more details, see sbg ECom device component output documentation.
